inv_stock_movements_sign_check.name: inv_stock_movements_sign_check
inv_stock_movements_sign_check.value: ("inv_stock_movements"."kind" in ('receipt', 'return') and "inv_stock_movements"."quantity" > 0) or ("inv_stock_movements"."kind" in ('issue', 'sale') and "inv_stock_movements"."quantity" < 0) or ("inv_stock_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "inv_stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0)

inv_variants_prices_check.name: inv_variants_prices_check
inv_variants_prices_check.value: ("inv_variants"."sale_price" is null or "inv_variants"."sale_price" >= 0) and ("inv_variants"."cost_price" is null or "inv_variants"."cost_price" >= 0)
